newsitem.title: USA: Rymer Foods Q3 sales cut by competition.
newsitem.headline: Rymer Foods Q3 sales cut by competition.

text.p: Rymer Foods Inc said sales for the third quarter ended July 27 declined 33 percent from a year ago as sales volume was cut by increased competition.
Sales for the quarter fell to $26.2 million from $39.1 million a year earlier. Rymer's net loss for the quarter was $0.12 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.14.
Rymer said the third quarter loss was about half the loss for the 1996 second quarter of $0.23 a share.
"...(W)e are beginning to see real improvements in some of our operating efficiencies and some very strong responses from our growing customer base," P. Edward Schenk, president, said in a statement.
